Examination Management Portal • V2

Seamless Examination Scheduling, Slot Booking & Rubric Evaluation

A unified platform for academic administrators, examiners, and students. Streamlining timelines, examiner availability, slot allocation, rubric-driven assessments, and asynchronous background jobs.

Administrator

Pre-existing superuser with centralized control over curriculum courses, examinations, rubric criteria, examiner provisioning, scheduling timelines, and result publication.

  • Course & Exam Management
  • Rubric Setup & Weightage
  • Slot Rescheduling & Overrides
  • Monthly Analytics & Reports
Examiner

Faculty members provisioned by the Administrator. Create and publish examination slots during creation windows, view booked student rosters, and assess candidates against rubrics.

  • Slot Creation & Capacity Controls
  • View Booked Student Rosters
  • Rubric Criterion Scoring
  • Marks & Feedback Submission
Student

Self-register and search available examinations. Book slots with real-time capacity validation, receive automatic reminders, view published marks and download official scorecards.

  • Self Registration & Profile
  • Search & Filter Examinations
  • Slot Booking & Cancellation
  • Async CSV Export & Scorecards
